en.title: Prepare Notification
en.description:
If the message is too long, keep the longest prefix of complete words and append a space and an ellipsis; otherwise return it unchanged; if even the first word does not fit, output just the ellipsis.

The standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site are given under "Input".
en.input: 3≤K≤500; the message has 1..500 characters, consisting of letters and single spaces. The first line contains K, and the second line contains the message.
en.output: Output the notification, whose length is ≤K.
en.explanation: Try adding complete words one at a time, and keep only the longest prefix whose length with the ellipsis does not exceed K.
hints: Try adding complete words one at a time, and keep only the longest prefix whose length with the ellipsis does not exceed K.
